collection.title: DS DS3 Hatchback 2016 to 2019 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: All of the following wiper blades will fit a DS3 Hatchback 2016 - 2019 model which requires a 24" wiper blade on the drivers side and a 16" for the passengers side. This model uses the Bayonet arm attachment to fix the blade to the wiper arm. We also have rear blade available, please click on the Rear Blades tab below.
